data.name: Itimad
data.gender_notes: Itimad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person or thing on which one relies, a source of support, something that inspires trust and confidence, an object of veneration and respect, a person who is trusted and relied upon. The name Itimad carries the meaning “Trust, faith, relying on God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Itimad usually hope their child will grow to embody trust, faith, relying on god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to trust in Allah's plan and seek His protection
data.etymology: Itimad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trust, faith, relying on God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Itimad total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
